research_gap.evidence: Focused 14-work closest-literature matrix; individual components are not claimed as novel.

methodological_contribution.evidence: PI-MCS physics residual, hierarchical calibration and exact/robust risk-budget system implemented with tests.

real_data_baselines.evidence: Seven methods on 193,275 real PRC intervals with route-cluster confidence intervals and paired comparisons.

validation_design.evidence: Temporal, route, aircraft, family and seasonal holdouts plus grouped nested CV and leakage tests.

data_breadth.evidence: April-October 2025, anonymized operators; multi-year/operator claims are excluded.

generalization_evidence.evidence: Only four October intervals belong to the one type absent from training.

statistics.evidence: Route-cluster 95% CIs and paired comparisons run; Holm/BH, effects and sensitivity code implemented.

interpretability.evidence: Real refit ablations, permutation importance and exact TreeSHAP on the metadata benchmark; full-feature analysis remains unevaluated.

reproducibility.evidence: Isolated branch, exact environment, fixed seeds, hashes, manuscript builder and 42 passing tests across original and extension suites.

external_confirmation.evidence: No future-confirmation labels accessed; guard and access log are active.

reviewer_conclusion: Stronger than a dashboard prototype and suitable for a methods-development manuscript, but not yet defensible as a completed Q1 empirical paper because multi-year, operator, full unseen-aircraft and independent external PI-MCS evidence are absent.
